info.name: DuitLHDN API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for DuitLHDN MyInvois Middleware.

## Variable Naming Convention
- `baseUrl` - API base URL
- `accessToken` - JWT access token (15min expiry)
- `refreshToken` - JWT refresh token (7 days expiry)
- `posToken` - Long-lived POS token (10 years)
- `companyId` - Company UUID
- `trackingId` - Internal tracking ID (e.g., HASH-abc123)
- `myinvoisUuid` - MyInvois document UUID (26 chars)
- `myinvoisLongId` - MyInvois long ID for sharing
- `posInvoiceId` - POS invoice ID for QR (e.g., BP-12345678)
- `invoiceNumber` - Original invoice number

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer token authentication.
POS endpoints use long-lived tokens.
Public endpoints require no authentication.

## Environments
- Production: https://api.duitlhdn.com
- Local: http://localhost:3000

item.name: 5. Invoice Submission
item.description:
Submit invoices to MyInvois LHDN.

**Required Permission:** `submit:invoice`

request.description:
Submit consolidated invoice (multiple small sales combined into one e-invoice).

**Use for:** Daily B2C sales without buyer details.

**Response:**
- `trackingId` - Internal tracking ID
- `invoiceNumber` - Your invoice number
- `posInvoiceId` - QR code ID
- `status` - SUBMITTING/SUBMITTED

**Response includes `links` when status is VALID:**
